title: Maula Hussain ka Matam
body:
Hussain Hussain Hussain
Maula Hussain Ka Matam...
1) Chand Suraj Sarey Malaq
Burhe Bachey Aur Naujawaan (x2)
Karta Hai Aaj Saara Aalam
2) Maula Dua Hai Hamari
Tera Matam Rahey Jaari (x2)
Bibi Zaynab Ka Hai Matam
3) Amara Saathe Dua Che
Amne Khuda Ni Madad Che (x2)
Kare Che Aaje Ame Matam
4) Madina Chori Ne Maula
Poycha Che Karbobala Ma (x2)
Aa Che Mazloom Nu Matam
5) Abbas-o-Akbar Nu Matam
Ali Asghar Hur Nu Matam (x2)
Shaheed-e-Karbal Nu Matam
6) Assanji Sathe Dua Aay
Sathe Khuda Ji Madad Aay (x2)
Kareta Aje Ayjo Matam
7) Qassim-o-Akbar Abbas Jo
Aun-o-Mohammad Asghar Bhi Jo...
Mazloom Maula Jo Matam
Hussain Hussain Hussain
